loot: Use case: stylized-concept. One production inventory icon atlas for a Chinese Three Kingdoms hand-painted strategy browser game. EXACT 4 columns by 8 rows, 32 perfectly equal square cells, overall portrait 1024x2048. Each icon centered within its 256x256 cell with 24px empty margin, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Identical flat light warm parchment background (#eadcba), NOT transparency, no labels, text, numbers, frames, dividers or watermarks. Each image depicts only the equipment, never the warrior. Rich ink outlines, gouache texture, readable chunky silhouettes, muted emerald, rusty copper, dark iron, aged wood, restrained colors matching humorous ancient Chinese game art. Exact cell contents in row-major order: Row1: heavy straight iron spear with vibration-ring ornament; wavy serpent spear with small green protective pennant; hooked long glaive; broad crescent guandao with circular blade ornament. Row2: feather fan with curled gust ribbon; green wind-control pennant on short rod; recurve signal bow with red signal ribbon; short recurve bow and three spread arrows. Row3: barbed spear; long formation lance alongside a second parallel lance; round shield with coiled catching rope; pair of hinged shields opened in two directions. Row4: hunting crossbow with small red target pennant; repeating crossbow with weighted blunt bolts; leather sling holding one heavy gray stone beside a broken drumstick; open sling pouch spilling gravel. Row5: low wooden capture cage with rope loop; hinged folding spiked barricade; spiked rolling log attached to iron chain; tied bundle of broken heavy timbers. Row6: wooden barrel of viscous dark blue oil; clay fire pot with short lit fuse; heavy ballista winch with hooked rope bolt; heavy iron armor-piercing ballista bolt resting on wooden crossbow stock. Row7: bundled throwing net with corner weights; stone-filled catapult basket; rope snare with copper bell; two joined rope snares. Row8: unrolled bamboo redeployment scroll with jade seal and red tie; upright emerald lure banner with gold disk emblem on wooden stand; blue gray ceramic smoke pot with pale wisps; closed small military supply chest. All 32 DIFFERENT icons must appear in these exact fixed slots, consistent crisp quality across every row, complete objects fully contained. This is a final in-game icon sheet, not a concept board.
props: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: one 3 by 3 game sprite atlas, square 1536x1536, nine equal 512x512 cells in exact rows/columns, NO visible cell separators. Based on reference designs: Chinese Three Kingdoms humorous hand-painted 2D defense game, thick dark ink outlines, warm wood, muted emerald cloth and ochre metal, crisp readable silhouettes. Generate actual RGBA transparency, fully transparent empty background, no checkerboard rendered into pixels, no colored backdrop, no ground plane. Keep all sprites entirely inside their assigned cell with 40px clear margins, centered with bottom baseline at 460px within each cell. Row1 from left: (1) wooden rockfall release hoist holding one large gray boulder, emerald signal ribbon; (2) matching empty hoist after release, boulder absent and hinged gate down; (3) standing goofy straw decoy dressed as Liu Bei in pale green robe, stitched cloth face, fake black beard, straw hands and feet. Row2 left: (4) broad dark wooden enemy landing boat with dragon prow facing LEFT, small tattered red pennant, no people; (5) friendly wooden covered ferry, emerald bamboo canopy and warm hanging lantern, prow facing LEFT, no people; (6) torn ochre paper parachute with snapped cords, no person. Row3 left: (7) tall emerald lure banner with gold round emblem, freestanding sturdy base, no writing; (8) small ceramic blue gray smoke pot with curling pale smoke, readable full silhouette; (9) open military bamboo scroll with jade seal and crimson binding, no text. Items 4 and 5 have a slightly elevated side view, not isometric top down, and share scale. Artwork only, no lettering, no UI frames, no labels, no watermarks. These are final independent sprites for compositing over scenery. Input images are STYLE AND OBJECT REFERENCES only; reconstruct the nine sprites in this new regular atlas with REAL transparent outside pixels.
alphaEdit: Edit this exact 3-by-3 sprite atlas. Keep all nine illustrated objects, shapes, colors, scale and positions. Remove the entire gray-and-white checkerboard background everywhere, including between ropes, spokes and beneath objects. The checkerboard must NOT be painted into the file. Output a real RGBA PNG with alpha=0 for every empty/background pixel, ready to composite directly over a game battlefield. Keep smoke partially transparent. Do not add any floor or shadow outside each object. Do not recreate a checkerboard to indicate transparency; actual alpha channel is essential. Retain the existing layout, no text.
